Subject: PoC / Deployment mode follow-up — Acme Corp (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid discussion about traffic patterns and compliance needs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before drafting the PoC plan: 

Call recap:
- Primary objective: evaluate Redwood for inference serving of Acme's customer-facing recommendation engine.
- Deployment modes discussed: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs, predictable throughput), Private VPC (customer-managed network).
- Acme constraints: VPC connectivity and SOC2 evidence were called out as important; on-prem not required unless roadmap changes.

Open items / asks for PoC scoping:
1) Please confirm the preferred deployment mode for the POC (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).
2) Success criteria — we discussed throughput and latency targets, plus functional checks (model parity vs current infra). Please confirm the top 3 KPIs you want validated.
3) Stakeholders — who needs to be involved from your side for security, infra, and procurement?
4) Timeline — what is your target start date for a 3–6 week PoC?

Suggested PoC options (we can narrow once you confirm mode):
- Hosted API: 2–3 week proof of concept using our hosted endpoints; good for rapid validation (no infra setup).
- Dedicated capacity: 4–6 week PoC with a dedicated GPU pool, VPC peering, and performance/load testing (recommended if you need throughput predictability).
- Private VPC: 4–6 week POC with private control plane + customer VPC; includes KMS/HSM options (recommended if you need strict network isolation).

Attached: PoC_scope_acmecorp.pdf — draft scoping doc (high level).

Proposed next step: if you confirm preferred mode and stakeholders by EOD Friday (7/17), Marissa will send a detailed PoC plan and SOW draft.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Ben — great recap. A few confirmations from our side: 

1) Preferred mode for the POC: Dedicated capacity. We need predictable throughput for the recommendation engine to mirror production-like behavior. Hosted is interesting, but we want to validate the reserved capacity characteristics.

2) Success criteria (top priorities):
- Throughput: sustain 200 requests/sec (peak) with p95 latency < 350ms and p50 < 200ms.
- Correctness: model outputs parity check against our current baseline for a representative prompt set.
- Stability: no >1% error rate across a 24h soak run.

3) Stakeholders:
- Tom Li (CTO) — technical approval
- Me (Alicia) — product owner / PM for the PoC
- procurement@acmecorp.com — procurement/billing contact
- Security: security-team@acmecorp.com (will send SOC2 checklist shortly)

4) Timeline: We can target a July 27 kickoff and a 4- to 6-week PoC. Procurement needs SOW + pricing to start paperwork.

I'll attach the initial security checklist in a separate email. For procurement, please include an estimated cost for a 4-week Dedicated trial along with any implementation fees.

Great — thanks for the clear priorities, Alicia. Based on your confirmation we recommend the following PoC plan for Dedicated capacity: 

Proposed PoC (Dedicated capacity) — 4 weeks
- Week 0 (prep, 3–5 days): VPC peering + firewall rules, authentication (API keys), and routing policy setup.
- Week 1: Deploy model variant and run initial validation (model parity tests).
- Week 2: Load testing (gradual ramp to peak 200 req/sec), latency profiling, and KV/prefix cache tuning.
- Week 3: 24h soak test + error/stability analysis; run regression evals against your prompt set.
- Deliverables: performance report, cost estimate per 1M tokens, runbook for production rollout, and a decision readout.

Success criteria (aligned to your list):
- Reach sustained 200 rps with p95 < 350ms during load window.
- Parity evaluation: match or exceed baseline quality on our eval harness (we'll share the report).
- Stability: <1% error rate over 24h soak.

Attachments: SOW_draft_acme_dedicated.docx — draft SOW and trial pricing (estimates). Please review and flag any procurement/contract items.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Ben to provide estimated Dedicated 4-week pricing and internal approval path.
- We'll schedule kickoff for July 27th — proposed 30-minute technical kickoff (network + infra owners).

If that all looks good I can get the SOW finalized and send to procurement for signatures.

Thanks,
Marissa
